title: Nonlinear elliptic homogenization with the parametric Deep Ritz method
abstract: arXiv:2609.05778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Elliptic homogenization is used to determine coarse-grained properties of materials with features on small scales. When these small scale features have rapid, periodic fluctuations, the solution field corresponding to a homogenized constitutive relation closely resembles the true solution based on the heterogeneous material. This homogenized behavior of the material is computed from a cell problem, where a cell is defined to be one period of the fluctuating material. In the context of linear elliptic partial differential equations, the homogenized constitutive relation is defined simply by a constant coefficient tensor, but for nonlinear problems, the homogenized response depends on the macroscopic state and/or its gradient, thus requiring solutions to parametric cell problems. translated_title: 基于参数化Deep Ritz方法的非线性椭圆均匀化
translated_abstract: 椭圆均匀化用于确定具有小尺度特征的材料在粗粒化尺度上的性质。当这些小尺度特征具有快速的周期性波动时，基于均匀化本构关系得到的解场与基于非均匀材料的真实解非常接近。材料的这种均匀化行为通过求解胞元问题（cell problem）计算得到，其中一个胞元被定义为波动材料的一个周期。在线性椭圆偏微分方程的背景下，均匀化本构关系仅由一个常系数张量定义；但对于非线性问题，均匀化响应依赖于宏观状态和/或其梯度，因此需要求解参数化的胞元问题。在使用均匀化本构关系计算数值解时，拥有胞元问题解的可微表示是非常有用的。
tldr: 本文提出采用参数化Deep Ritz方法求解非线性椭圆均匀化中的参数化胞元问题，从而获得胞元问题解的可微表示，以支持非线性均匀化本构关系的数值计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the parametric Deep Ritz method to solve parametric cell problems arising in nonlinear elliptic homogenization, providing a differentiable representation of cell problem solutions for numerical computations with homogenized constitutive relations.
